name: Iron Sword
description: A sturdy iron longsword.

name: Worn Iron Sword
description: A well-used iron longsword. Merchants won't pay for it.

name: Wooden Shield
description: A round wooden shield.

name: Raven Shield
description: A round wooden shield painted with a black raven crest.

name: Leather Helmet
description: A simple leather helmet.

name: Iron Helmet
description: A heavy iron great helm that guards the whole head.

name: Breastplate
description: A polished steel breastplate that turns aside all but the truest blows.

name: Leather Pants
description: Durable leather leggings.

name: Iron Boots
description: Heavy iron boots.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Supple leather gloves with a sure grip.

name: Iron Gauntlets
description: Heavy iron gauntlets that shield the hands and wrists.

name: Leather Boots
description: Sturdy leather boots that tread softly.

name: Plate Greaves
description: Articulated steel greaves that guard the legs.

name: Plate Boots
description: Overlapping steel plates that guard the feet and shins.

name: Plate Helmet
description: A visored steel close helm that encases the whole head.

name: Plate Gauntlets
description: Articulated steel gauntlets that encase the hands and wrists.

name: Ring of Protection
description: A silver ring bearing a cross-emblazoned shield that wards off blows.

name: Gold Ring
description: A plain gold ring.

name: Silver Necklace
description: A delicate silver chain with a harvest medallion.

name: Leather Belt
description: A wide leather belt.

name: Dagger
description: A small but sharp dagger.

name: Goblin Sword
description: A crude short blade favored by goblins and orcs.

name: Small Sword
description: A compact crude blade sized for small fighters.

name: Morningstar
description: A spiked iron head on a leather-wrapped haft. Heavy and crude — but there is no edge to keep.

name: Greatclub
description: A limb of oak studded with iron thorns. Too heavy for anything smaller than an ogre to swing well.

name: Steel Longsword
description: A long steel blade with a ringed grip and a wheel pommel. Tempered steel keeps an edge that iron cannot hold.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocking metal rings forming armor.

name: Wool Cape
description: A heavy wool cape that hangs from the shoulders and trails as you walk.

name: Cape Dye
description: A stoppered bottle of pigment. Use it while wearing a cape to soak the cloth in a colour of your choosing.

name: Cape Transfer Kit
description: A waxed sheet and a pot of fixative. Use it while wearing a cape to print a picture of your own onto the cloth.

name: Torch
description: A flickering wooden torch.

name: Worn Torch
description: A stubby half-burnt torch. Merchants won't pay for it.

name: Spear
description: A long wooden-shafted spear tipped with iron.

name: Coin Pile
description: A small heap of loose copper coins.

name: Healing Potion
description: A crimson brew that knits wounds and restores vitality.

name: Scroll of Return
description: Reading the arcane runes whisks you back to town in a flash of light.

name: Scroll of Enchant Weapon
description: Arcane runes that hone your wielded weapon's edge — though greedy re-reading may destroy it.

name: Scroll of Enchant Armor
description: Arcane runes that harden a worn piece of your armor — though greedy re-reading may destroy it.

name: Scroll of Party Summon
description: Reading the runes calls your whole party to your side — each may answer or ignore the summons.

name: Phoenix Talisman
description: A stone tablet etched with a sunfire phoenix. Carry it and when you fall the bird stirs — you rise where you fell and the talisman crumbles to dust.

name: Table
description: A sturdy wooden table.

name: Leather Armor
description: Supple leather chest armor crossed with straps and buckles.

name: Mandolin
description: A round-backed mandolin with gilded fretwork. Strum up a tune with /play_music.

name: Worn Mandolin
description: A road-worn mandolin that still sings true. Strum up a tune with /play_music. Merchants won't pay for it.

name: Fishing Rod
description: A supple wooden rod with a horsehair line. Cast at water to fish.

name: Raw Minnow
description: A tiny silver fish. Barely a mouthful.

name: Raw Perch
description: A striped river perch. Decent eating.

name: Raw Trout
description: A speckled trout. Anglers respect it.

name: River Salmon
description: A powerful silver salmon. A proud catch.

name: Golden Sturgeon
description: An armoured river giant older than the kingdom. Its bony scutes shine like beaten gold.

name: Old Boot
description: A waterlogged leather boot. Someone had a worse day than you.

name: Clump of Kelp
description: A slimy tangle of seaweed dredged from the bottom.

name: Message in a Bottle
description: A sealed bottle with a scrap of paper inside. A collector might pay a little.

name: Sunken Coin Pouch
description: A drowned purse still holding a few coins.

name: Apple
description: A crisp red apple.

name: Bread
description: A fresh-baked loaf.

name: Cheese
description: A wedge of hard cheese. Keeps well on the road.

name: Jerky
description: Salted dried meat. Dense and easy to carry.

name: Lembas Wafer
description: Elven waybread wrapped in leaves. One thin wafer carries a traveller through a full day's march.

name: Grilled Minnow
description: A tiny fish crisped whole over a campfire.

name: Grilled Perch
description: A striped perch grilled to flaking.

name: Grilled Trout
description: A speckled trout smoky from the fire.

name: Grilled Salmon
description: A salmon fillet seared over open flame.

name: Grilled Sturgeon
description: A royal cut of sturgeon roasted on embers.

name: Campfire Kit
description: Firewood and tinder bundled for the road. Burns for ten minutes.

name: Busker's Hat
description: A weathered feathered hat. Set it down before a performance and listeners drop coins in it. Use it again to pick it up.
